class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Schedule actions in Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div><p>You can make Gemini a part of your daily, weekly, and monthly routines by scheduling recurring actions. For example, you can schedule actions in Gemini Apps to get:</p>

<ul>
  <li>A daily news digest on topics that matter most to you</li>
  <li>Weekly inspiration for creative projects</li>
  <li>Monthly suggestions for new skills to learn</li>
</ul>

<p>You can set a delivery time that works for your schedule. Gemini will prepare your content in the background so it’s ready by the scheduled time.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="reqs">What you need</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> We’re gradually making this feature available to all personal Google Accounts, so it might not be available to you just yet.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><p>To schedule actions in Gemini Apps, you must:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Sign in to Gemini Apps with one of the following accounts:</strong>

    <ul>
      <li>A personal Google Account.</li>
      <li>A work or school Google Account with access to a <a href="/gemini/answer/14620100" rel="noopener">qualifying edition of Google Workspace</a>.</li>
      <li><a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Have </strong><a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><strong>Keep Activity</strong></a><strong> on.</strong> This feature isn't available when this setting is off.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="16319422"></gkms-context-selector><h2 id="schedule_action">Schedule an action</h2>

<div><strong>Important: </strong>You can have up to 10 active scheduled actions at a time.</div>

<div><ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>In the text box at the bottom, enter your prompt. <a href="#example">Get ideas for how to use scheduled actions</a>.
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Tip:</strong> In your prompt, provide details about when and how often you want to schedule the action.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/g2svh5vRbDsKjL_bYZLtRARtJ9sd-qFGFI_ikEx9E6uMiw-ozJbf412dACT0za2X-To=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/g2svh5vRbDsKjL_bYZLtRARtJ9sd-qFGFI_ikEx9E6uMiw-ozJbf412dACT0za2X-To">. Gemini will reply with a summary of your scheduled action.
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Without a Google AI plan:</strong> Gemini will prepare your content up to several hours in advance to ensure it’s delivered on time.</li>
      <li><strong>With a Google AI plan:</strong> Gemini will prepare your content within the hour leading up to your delivery time to help ensure you get the latest information.</li>
      <li>Responses for scheduled actions are prepared in advance to guarantee timely delivery. As a result, rapidly changing data, like stock prices, won’t be the latest when you receive them. Scheduled actions work best for daily summaries and wrap-ups.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>

<div><p><strong>Tips: </strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>To update the action schedule or instructions, click More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Edit</strong>. You can also ask Gemini to edit the action at any time in the scheduled action chat.</li>
  <li>You can also manage and create scheduled actions in your Gemini settings. Click Settings &amp; help <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Scheduled actions</strong>.</li>
  <li>If you ask Gemini Apps to schedule an action that uses another app, like Google Workspace, that app must be connected. If it's not, Gemini will ask you to connect the app. Learn how to <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044" rel="noopener">use and manage Connected Apps in Gemini</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h3 id="example">Examples</h3>

<div><p>Here are a few examples of ways you can have Gemini help you using scheduled actions.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Daily digests</strong> of your calendar, to-do list, and emails to help you prepare for the day ahead.</li>
  <li><strong>Daily topic tracking</strong> to stay up to date on the latest breakthroughs and trends for any subject you're following online.</li>
  <li><strong>Daily market reports</strong> tracking your stock portfolio, cryptocurrency prices, and the latest financial news from the past day.</li>
  <li><strong>Daily weather forecasts</strong> paired with outfit ideas based on a list of your personal wardrobe items.</li>
  <li><strong>Daily practice quizzes</strong> to help you master a new language, professional skill, or hobby.</li>
  <li><strong>Daily creative prompts</strong> or artistic inspiration to jumpstart your personal projects every morning.</li>
  <li><strong>Weekly news digests</strong> or details about upcoming tour dates and releases for your favorite musical artists.</li>
  <li><strong>Weekly rollups</strong> of new local cafes and restaurants to check out over the weekend.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="action_notifications">Scheduled action notifications</h2>

<div><p>When each response is ready, Gemini will notify you:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>In the </strong><strong>Gemini </strong><strong>web app: </strong>In the menu under “Chats,” the chat with your scheduled action is marked as unread.</li>
  <li><strong>In the </strong><strong>Gemini </strong><strong>mobile app:</strong> You’ll get a notification on your mobile device. The notification may appear when your device is locked depending on your settings.
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Tip: </strong>You can turn notifications for Gemini Apps on or off in your device’s app notification settings.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="pause_resume_scheduled_action">Pause or resume a scheduled action</h2>

<div><p>You can pause an action without deleting the scheduled action. If you pause an action, Gemini won’t run your prompt until you resume the action.</p>

<ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>At the bottom, click Settings &amp; help <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Scheduled actions <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/myrHyVCbxh30UxkA9HQ60ZftxWISzkPz1X30znEUrRnTwMk5_o2W0IxCPXVzwjSysac=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/myrHyVCbxh30UxkA9HQ60ZftxWISzkPz1X30znEUrRnTwMk5_o2W0IxCPXVzwjSysac">.</li>
  <li>Find the scheduled action that you want to pause or resume.
    <ul>
      <li>To pause an action, turn it off <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/B_qS32AqHelobhLdFSN_oB5VLFAp9UF4ITShWbuWOKbohQRd_S6onkhq4xVuUBINsA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/B_qS32AqHelobhLdFSN_oB5VLFAp9UF4ITShWbuWOKbohQRd_S6onkhq4xVuUBINsA">.</li>
      <li>To resume an action, turn it on <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/KqijgcUmA1-8BvhhJtFLjvm-et0odaqT-S3C6g1NAqpkPfRI7uWtl9rcg0IBTVSiFME=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/KqijgcUmA1-8BvhhJtFLjvm-et0odaqT-S3C6g1NAqpkPfRI7uWtl9rcg0IBTVSiFME">.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2 id="edit_delete_scheduled_action">Edit or delete scheduled action</h2>

<div><p>In the chat with the scheduled action, you can ask Gemini to make changes to the action. These changes will be saved for future occurrences of the action.</p>

<p>You can also edit or delete scheduled actions in your Gemini settings. To do this:</p>

<ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>

<h2 id="location">Scheduled actions &amp; your location</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini Apps may use your location to provide more relevant responses to your prompts. For example, to respond to prompts about the weather, Gemini Apps need to know your location.</p>

<p>If you schedule an action that’s related to your location, Gemini Apps will use the location where you created the action for all future responses. To schedule an action for a different location, you can either create a new scheduled action or update your existing action to specify a location.</p>
<a href="/gemini/answer/13594961#location_info" rel="noopener">Learn more about the location information Gemini Apps collect, why, and how it is used</a>.</div>

<h2 id="why_off">Why a scheduled action may be turned off</h2>

<p>If you aren’t receiving responses for a scheduled action, it may have been automatically turned off due to inactivity. You can turn the scheduled action on again at any time. <a href="#pause_resume_scheduled_action" rel="noopener">Learn how to resume a scheduled action</a>.</p>
